name: Scenario 1: Happy Path Autonomous Processing
description: Agent parses clean JSON invoice, resolves ERP payload, registers invoice into company ERP, writes completion report, and independently verifies state against the ERP API.
task: Find the latest invoice from Acme Corp in demo/invoices/invoice_acme_001.json, extract the details, enter it into our ERP system, and verify completion.

name: Scenario 2: Autonomous Error Recovery & Adaptation
description: Agent attempts to parse malformed JSON file (invoice_malformed_003.json), detects JSONDecodeError, transitions to ADAPTING state, replans with plain-text regex heuristic fallback, recovers fields, and completes the workflow.
task: Process the invoice from demo/invoices/invoice_malformed_003.json and record it into our ERP system.

name: Scenario 3: Human-in-the-Loop Governance Escalation
description: Agent parses invoice with amount $75,000 exceeding the $10,000 threshold. It transitions to ESCALATED, halts, requests interactive approval, and proceeds only upon user authorization.
task: Process the high-value vendor invoice from demo/invoices/invoice_highvalue_004.json into our ERP system.

name: Scenario 4: Duplicate Invoice Prevention
description: Attempting to re-enter an already registered invoice triggers ERP 409 Conflict rejection, demonstrating idempotent safety handling.
task: Process the Acme Corp invoice from demo/invoices/invoice_acme_001.json into our ERP system again.
